summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Optimi Health Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its Management's Discussion and Analysis and condensed interim financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing also notes a 1-for-30 reverse stock split executed on May 19, 2026. There is no mention of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a standard quarterly report with no special-situation catalyst.
